summary: Procure ChartFlow analytics pilot: burst seats, SCIM provisioning, BYO-KMS terms, and SOX evidence
description: Issue summary: Procurement request for a ChartFlow analytics pilot license. Team (Data Platform) wants 30 named seats for core users plus 150 ephemeral burst seats for contractor/bench usage for Q2 pilot. ChartFlow requires SCIM provisioning, supports BYO-KMS for workspace encryption, and has an invoicing cadence that needs PO vs. credit-card routing. Legal/security require SOX-ready evidence and confirmation of KMS integration scope.
impact: Data Platform cannot start the paid pilot until seat entitlements, SCIM provisioning, and KMS contract language are agreed. Delays will push the pilot and downstream dashboard work by ~3 weeks and block cost/ROI evaluation needed for Q3 budget decision.
requirements: 1) Purchase 30 named seats (annual, enterprise plan) with option to enable 150 ephemeral seats billed monthly during pilot. 2) SCIM integration enabled for Okta provisioning (enterprise SSO tenant). 3) BYO-KMS support validated for workspace-level encryption; confirm supported key rotation and audit APIs. 4) Invoice to be paid via PO (Finance) with supplier W-9 on file. 5) Security evidence: SOC2 report, encryption diagram, data flow, and SOX-relevant attestations.
procurement_details: Vendor: ChartFlow Inc. Proposed terms: enterprise annual for named seats at $6,000/seat/yr, ephemeral seat add-on at $1/user/month (metered), 30-day net invoice. Requested start date: 2026-04-01 for pilot. Requested billing entity: Redwood Inference, cost center PLAT-42. Procurement contact: Jonas Meyer (Data Platform).
billing_and_po: Finance preference: PO required. Need vendor remit address and Tax ID. Please route quote to finance@redwood.com and cc procurement@redwood.com. Confirm whether ChartFlow accepts monthly usage invoices for ephemeral seats on the same PO or requires separate SKUs. If ChartFlow insists on credit-card for ephemeral usage, request an invoice-then-billable arrangement or set up interim charge card with reconciliation.
identity_provisioning: SCIM: ChartFlow supports SCIM v2. Need enterprise provisioning enabled with groups mapping (data-platform-admins, data-analysts, contractors). IDP: Okta. Required attributes: email, firstName, lastName, title, manager, employeeType. Request IDP/SIAM team to open SCIM integration ticket and provide sample mapping and test account in staging.
security_requirements: Security requests: SOC2 Type II report, data encryption at rest/in transit documentation, BYO-KMS architecture diagram, supported KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), access controls for service accounts, and list of sub-processors. Legal: review BYO-KMS clause to ensure Redwood retains key control and ChartFlow can't export plaintext. Need SLA for key rotation and incident notification timeline <72 hours.
timeline: Desired timeline: contract + PO signed by 2026-03-26 to meet pilot start 2026-04-01. SCIM integration staging test by 2026-03-23. Security review completed by 2026-03-25. Finance to approve PO by 2026-03-24.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Signed SOW or MSA with BYO-KMS clause accepted by Legal. 2) PO issued and vendor invoice terms clarified. 3) SCIM provisioning test between Okta and ChartFlow staging completes with group sync. 4) Security obtains SOC2 and KMS docs and confirms no high-risk sub-processors. 5) Seats provisioned in ChartFlow admin for 30 named users and ephemeral seat metering enabled.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12: Initial vendor quote received from ChartFlow, attached to Confluence page. 2026-03-13: Security flagged that ChartFlow's default encryption uses vendor-managed keys; BYO-KMS is a paid add-on requiring separate contract clause. 2026-03-13: Finance requested vendor Tax ID and domestic bank details. 2026-03-14: Legal requested sample BYO-KMS contract language from ChartFlow; vendor indicated standard clause available but needs redlines for key custody language.
comments: Maya Rivers (Reporter) - 2026-03-12: Opening procurement ticket — pilot approved by Data Platform leads. Attaching vendor quote and pilot acceptance criteria.
Jonas Meyer (Data Platform) - 2026-03-13: Confirming list of named users — attached roster. Also confirming we will use contractors intermittently; ephemeral seats should auto-scale.

Priya Shah (Security) - 2026-03-13: Requested SOC2 and KMS architecture. ChartFlow said BYO-KMS is supported for Enterprise, but need clause to ensure Redwood holds the key material. Marking as security blocker.
Evan Torres (Finance) - 2026-03-14: Finance needs vendor W-9 and Tax ID. Also confirm whether vendor requires net-30 vs net-15. PO processing ETA 3 business days after docs received.
Liam O'Connell (Assignee) - 2026-03-14: Reached out to ChartFlow account rep for BYO-KMS sample clause and SCIM staging tenant details. Awaiting response, expected 48h.
next_steps: 1) Procurement to collect vendor W-9, Tax ID, and remit info (Assigned: Procurement). 2) Legal to review BYO-KMS clause and propose redlines (Assigned: Legal). 3) IDP team to schedule SCIM test window with ChartFlow staging (Assigned: IDP). 4) Security to review SOC2 and KMS artifacts once provided (Assigned: Security). 5) Finance to prepare PO once vendor docs complete (Assigned: Finance).
notes_for_followup: If ChartFlow cannot commit to BYO-KMS under acceptable contract terms, fallback options: a) proceed with vendor-managed keys for pilot and restrict datasets (PII removed) or b) choose alternative vendor with explicit BYO-KMS support. Track budget variance for ephemeral seats separately and include in Q3 procurement review.
